FileData.description:
What was read from the file, as the extract workflow records it (c-250): the document type and version it was
read as, whether a template or the model read it, how many fields wait for a person, and the extraction. A file read
with Detect whose kind is none of the team's types has no type and no version: it was not recognised (c-335).
FileData.title: FileData

FileList.description: A page of files, the counts of each view the Files page offers, and facet counts, all from the query.
FileList.title: FileList

FileRow.description: A list row: the file record without versions and references.
FileRow.title: FileRow

Option.description:
One choice in a picker: what it stores, what it shows, a short hint, and why it cannot be chosen when it
cannot (the agent lacks a tool the widget needs, say).
Option.title: Option

OptionsPage.description:
A page of a picker's choices, searched and limited in the store query. `next_cursor` asks for the next page;
None at the end. Every `/options` route answers this, and `ids=` resolves stored values to their labels.
OptionsPage.title: OptionsPage

ReadRequest.description: A read request and the system extract run it started, once the event was delivered.
ReadRequest.title: ReadRequest

ReadRequestIn.description:
Read the file with a team's document type (c-250), the newest version when none is named; with no type, the file
is classified over the team's types and read with the one found (Detect, c-335).
ReadRequestIn.title: ReadRequestIn

StorageTarget.description: Where one purpose's bytes go. `default` covers every purpose without its own target.
StorageTarget.title: StorageTarget

get.description: This service's background processes and their state; counts and error types only, no record's data.

Available files of the caller's team, newest first; `uploadedBy=me` keeps the caller's own. Search, the
uploaded-since date, the view and the purpose, scan, sensitivity, read-as type and read path filters run in
the query, which also answers each view's count and the facet counts; `readPath=model` keeps files no
template matched.

post.description:
A file written in one request, the bytes as the body, with the same checks as a browser upload (files F19).
A service names the person it writes for in `uploadedBy`; a person is always the uploader.
